tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Search currently available houses with land. Logged-out. Uses the same eligible inventory and filters as /for-sale/.

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Full public detail for one home: price, land, source, evidence, save link. Logged-out. Only rights-cleared published homes resolve.

tools.name: home_buyer_questions
tools.description: The 20 rural buyer due-diligence questions for one home, with only source-checked answers filled in. Missing coverage is reported as unassessed, never asserted.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: List the caller's private saved-homes board. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: board_save
tools.description: Save an available home to the caller's board. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: board_update
tools.description: Move a saved home between stages or edit private notes. Requires Bearer token. Stages: saved, researching, viewing, shortlist, offer, passed.
